## Delivery horizons

- Foundation: build an authoritative requirement-to-code-to-test matrix from the official 2026-07-28 schema and changelog.
- Protocol core: adopt stateless per-request version and capability metadata plus mandatory server discovery and result types.
- Interaction and streaming: implement multi round-trip requests, subscription listening, progress, cancellation, and extension negotiation.
- Server and extension surface: complete tools, resources, prompts, tasks, skills, and MCP Apps where pm exposes useful capabilities.
- Trust boundary: implement transport headers, cache policy, JSON Schema 2020-12 behavior, authorization issuer binding, telemetry propagation, consent, and deprecation migrations.
- Proof: test official schema conformance, legacy probes, negative cases, real stdio and Streamable HTTP processes, packed installs, npx, bunx, and exact released artifacts.

## Architecture constraint

Protocol semantics and typed envelopes belong to the public SDK. The CLI and MCP process are thin adapters. Compatibility is explicit, versioned, bounded, and never inferred from connection-local state.
MCP 2026-07-28 conformance programme: stateless protocol, discovery, MRTR, subscriptions, extensions, security, caching, and released-artifact proof

Migrate the pm MCP platform from the 2025-06-18 initialize-based implementation to complete 2026-07-28 conformance, with SDK-owned protocol contracts, explicit legacy compatibility, real transport tests, and release gates.

The official 2026-07-28 TypeScript schema and changelog are mapped requirement by requirement to a canonical owner, implementation surface, positive test, negative test, documentation section, and release gate; Every applicable core request and result uses stateless per-request protocol metadata and the server implements mandatory discovery with deterministic capability and identity reporting; MRTR, required resultType handling, subscriptions/listen, revised tasks, caching metadata, transport headers, schema behavior, authorization rules, trace propagation, and deprecation migrations are covered by individually tracked children; Resources, prompts, tools, official extensions, and client-facing features are explicitly implemented, explicitly declared not applicable with evidence, or tracked behind a standards-based compatibility boundary; Public SDK entrypoints own protocol negotiation, validation, envelopes, capabilities, and transport-neutral behavior while CLI and MCP layers contain no private policy fork; Real-process stdio and Streamable HTTP conformance suites prove success and refusal behavior against supported and unsupported versions, malformed metadata, disconnects, retries, cache scopes, authorization issuers, and extension negotiation; Packed and published artifacts are installed and verified through npm, npx, bunx, and the MCP release probe before a release can be advertised
Make every applicable MCP 2026-07-28 core requirement and official extension reachable through SDK-owned contracts and verified over real transports
Agents and hosts can integrate pm through a current interoperable protocol without hand-maintained drift or legacy-session assumptions

The shipped server advertises 2025-06-18 and requires initialize while the latest specification is stateless and changes negotiation, streaming, requests, caching, extensions, transport, and security contracts
